seen:=array_append(seen,lower(token));CONTINUE;\n  END IF;\n  IF jsonb_typeof(item) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RETURN false;END IF;\n  FOR k IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(item)LOOP IF k NOT (jsonb_typeof(item->k) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR length(item->>k)>2000 OR ((item->>k)<>'' AND (item->>k)!~'^https://[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9.-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?(:[0-9]{1,5})?([/?#][^[:space:]<>]*)?$'))
